purpose: Context KB for pain.002.001.10 CustomerPaymentStatusReport auto-fixing. For each XML tag: datatype, mandatory, errors, possible_fixes.

iso_20022_rules.R1_OrgnlGroupInformation: OrgnlGrpInfAndSts is mandatory and must reference the original message via OrgnlMsgId and OrgnlMsgNmId.
iso_20022_rules.R2_StatusReasonOnReject: If a transaction or group status is RJCT, the corresponding StsRsnInf (status reason) should be present to explain the rejection.
iso_20022_rules.R3_ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus: GrpSts, PmtInfSts and TxSts values must be valid ExternalPaymentGroupStatus / ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus codes.
iso_20022_rules.R4_OriginalIdentification: OrgnlInstrId, OrgnlEndToEndId, OrgnlTxId and OrgnlUETR must be copied unchanged from the original (reported) message.
iso_20022_rules.R5_StatusReasonCode: StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd must be a valid ExternalStatusReason1Code (e.g. AC01, AM04, MS03) or NARR when free-text is supplied in AddtlInf.
iso_20022_rules.R6_PartialAcceptance: GrpSts = PART (partially accepted) requires per-transaction TxSts to be populated so accepted and rejected items are distinguishable.
iso_20022_rules.R7_OriginalMessageNameIdentifier: OrgnlMsgNmId identifies the reported message type (e.g. pain.001.001.09) and must be a valid ISO 20022 message identifier.
iso_20022_rules.XSD_BICFIPattern: BICFIDec2014Identifier: [A-Z0-9]{4}[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})? — applies to AppHdr/Fr, AppHdr/To and all FinInstnId/BICFI in the status report.
iso_20022_rules.XSD_AmountConstraints: ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount (used in ChrgsInf/Amt in TxInfAndSts): fractionDigits=5, totalDigits=18, minInclusive=0. Ccy attribute required.
iso_20022_rules.XSD_StatusCodeNARR_AddtlInf: ISO 20022 base rule (R16 in pacs.002): If StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd = NARR, then AddtlInf MUST be present in the same StsRsnInf block.
iso_20022_rules.XSD_V14Changes_pain002: pain.002.001.14 (latest XSD) vs 001.10: TxInfAndSts/ChrgsInf removed (was optional in 001.10, removed in 001.14). TxInfAndSts/AccptncDtTm removed. TxInfAndSts/AcctSvcrRef removed. OrgnlTxRef added at TxInfAndSts level with full original transaction details.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules: AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.02' for the status report exchange under CBPR+ SR2025.
AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'pain.002.001.10' and match the Document namespace.
AppHdr/CreDt and all ISODateTime fields must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; the 'Z' suffix and milliseconds are forbidden.
AppHdr/Fr and AppHdr/To must carry valid BIC8 or BIC11 (ISO 9362) identifiers when exchanged on the SWIFT network.
GrpSts, PmtInfSts and TxSts must use codes from the ExternalPaymentGroupStatus / ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus lists.
If TxSts = RJCT (or PmtInfSts = RJCT / GrpSts = RJCT) then at least one StsRsnInf with Rsn/Cd must be present.
OrgnlUETR, when present, must be a valid lowercase UUID v4 and must match the UETR of the original transaction.
All proprietary/text fields are limited to the FIN-X character set; accented characters must be transliterated to ASCII.
StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd must be a valid ExternalStatusReason1Code; use NARR with AddtlInf when no specific code applies.

tags.description: Business Application Header V02. Mandatory for all CBPR+ messages including pain.002 status reports.

errors.description: AppHdr element is absent; CBPR+ mandates BusinessApplicationHeaderV02.
possible_fixes: Insert a complete <AppHdr> block before the <Document> element.
Ensure AppHdr contains Fr, To, BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc and CreDt.

tags.description: Sending MessagingEndpoint. Must contain a BIC8 or BIC11 when exchanged on SWIFT.

errors.description: Fr element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <Fr><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{sender_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></Fr> inside AppHdr.
Use the BIC of the institution issuing the status report.

errors.description: AppHdr/Fr contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters per ISO 9362.
Example valid BIC: DEUTDEFFXXX

tags.description: Receiving MessagingEndpoint. Must contain a BIC8 or BIC11 on SWIFT.

errors.description: To element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <To><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{receiver_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></To> inside AppHdr.
Use the BIC of the institution that receives the status report (typically the original instructing party).

errors.description: AppHdr/To contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters per ISO 9362.

tags.description: Unique identifier of the Business Message. Must equal Document/CstmrPmtStsRpt/GrpHdr/MsgId.

errors.description: BizMsgIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Copy the value of GrpHdr/MsgId and insert as <BizMsgIdr>{MsgId_value}</BizMsgIdr>.
If MsgId is also absent, generate a unique Max35Text value (e.g. STS-20260601-001).

errors.description: AppHdr/BizMsgIdr does not equal Document/CstmrPmtStsRpt/GrpHdr/MsgId.
possible_fixes: Read GrpHdr/MsgId and set BizMsgIdr to the same value.
If BizMsgIdr is the source of truth, update GrpHdr/MsgId to match.
Never invent a new value — always harvest from the other field.

errors.description: BizMsgIdr exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate the value to a maximum of 35 characters.
Synchronize the truncated value back to GrpHdr/MsgId.

tags.description: Message Definition Identifier. Must exactly match the Document namespace identifier.

errors.description: MsgDefIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <MsgDefIdr>pain.002.001.10</MsgDefIdr> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr does not match the Document xmlns namespace identifier.
possible_fixes: Read the xmlns attribute from the Document root (e.g. urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.002.001.10).
Set MsgDefIdr to 'pain.002.001.10' with no trailing spaces or version mismatch.

tags.description: Business Service identifier. Must be 'swift.cbprplus.02' for the CBPR+ status report exchange.

errors.description: BizSvc is absent; it is mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Insert <BizSvc>swift.cbprplus.02</BizSvc> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: BizSvc contains an incorrect value.
possible_fixes: Replace value with 'swift.cbprplus.02' for the CBPR+ status report service.

tags.description: Creation date/time of the Business Message. Must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; Z suffix and milliseconds forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDt>{current datetime as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00}</CreDt> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt uses 'Z' suffix which is forbidden under CBPR+.
AppHdr/CreDt has no timezone offset.

tags.description: Unique identifier of the status report message assigned by the reporting party. Must equal AppHdr/BizMsgIdr. No spaces.

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgId is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <MsgId>{unique identifier up to 35 chars}</MsgId> as first child of GrpHdr.
Use format STS-YYYYMMDD-NNN (e.g. STS-20260601-001).
Ensure the same value is in AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to maximum 35 characters preserving a meaningful prefix.
Synchronize truncated value to AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.

errors.description: MsgId contains characters outside the FIN-X character set or contains spaces.
possible_fixes: Remove spaces from MsgId.
Replace special/accented characters with ASCII equivalents.
Allowed: A-Z a-z 0-9 / - ? : ( ) . , ' + (no leading or trailing spaces).

tags.description: Creation date and time of the status report. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. Z suffix and milliseconds forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: GrpHdr/CreDtTm is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDtTm>{current datetime as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00}</CreDtTm>.

errors.description: CreDtTm uses 'Z' suffix; forbidden under CBPR+.
CreDtTm has no timezone offset; forbidden under CBPR+.

tags.description: Identifier of the original (reported) message, copied unchanged from GrpHdr/MsgId of the original pain.001/pacs message.

errors.description: OrgnlMsgId is absent from OrgnlGrpInfAndSts.
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlMsgId>{original message MsgId}</OrgnlMsgId> copied from the reported message GrpHdr/MsgId.
Harvest the value from the original message being acknowledged; do not invent.

errors.description: OrgnlMsgId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 35 characters; the value must still match the original message identifier.

tags.description: Message name identifier of the original (reported) message, e.g. pain.001.001.09. Identifies the message type being acknowledged.

errors.description: OrgnlMsgNmId is absent from OrgnlGrpInfAndSts.
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlMsgNmId>pain.001.001.09</OrgnlMsgNmId> with the identifier of the original reported message.
Use the exact message identifier of the instrument being acknowledged (e.g. pain.001.001.09).

errors.description: OrgnlMsgNmId is not a recognised ISO 20022 message identifier.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid ISO 20022 message identifier, e.g. pain.001.001.09.
Ensure the format is <namespace>.<number>.<variant>.<version>.

tags.description: Creation date/time of the original (reported) message, copied unchanged. Optional. Z suffix and milliseconds forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: OrgnlCreDtTm uses 'Z' suffix which is forbidden under CBPR+.
OrgnlCreDtTm has no timezone offset.
possible_fixes: Append a UTC offset matching the original message. Example: 2026-05-30T09:00:00 -> 2026-05-30T09:00:00+00:00.

tags.description: Group-level status of the original message (ExternalPaymentGroupStatus). PART indicates partial acceptance and requires per-transaction TxSts.

errors.description: GrpSts contains a value not in the ExternalPaymentGroupStatus codelist.
possible_fixes: Replace with one of: ACCP, ACSC, ACSP, ACWC, ACWP, PART, PDNG, RJCT, RCVD.
Use RJCT for full rejection, ACCP for technically accepted, PART for partial acceptance.

errors.description: GrpSts = RJCT but no StsRsnInf is present to explain the group-level rejection.
possible_fixes: Insert <StsRsnInf><Rsn><Cd>{reason code}</Cd></Rsn></StsRsnInf> under OrgnlGrpInfAndSts.
Use a valid ExternalStatusReason1Code (e.g. AC01, AM04, MS03) or NARR with AddtlInf.

tags.description: Group-level status reason code (ExternalStatusReason1Code). Use NARR with AddtlInf when no specific code applies.

errors.description: Group-level StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd is not a valid ExternalStatusReason1Code.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid ExternalStatusReason1Code (e.g. AC01, AM04, MS03).
Use NARR and place free-text explanation in StsRsnInf/AddtlInf when no code fits.

tags.description: Identifier of the original PaymentInformation block being reported, copied unchanged from the original message PmtInf/PmtInfId. Mandatory when OrgnlPmtInfAndSts is present.

errors.description: OrgnlPmtInfId is absent from OrgnlPmtInfAndSts.
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlPmtInfId>{original PmtInfId}</OrgnlPmtInfId> copied from the reported message.
Harvest the value from the original PaymentInformation block; do not invent.

errors.description: OrgnlPmtInfId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 35 characters; value must still match the original PmtInfId.

tags.description: Status of the original PaymentInformation block (ExternalPaymentGroupStatus). PART requires per-transaction TxSts.

errors.description: PmtInfSts contains a value not in the ExternalPaymentGroupStatus codelist.
possible_fixes: Replace with one of: ACCP, ACSC, ACSP, ACWC, ACWP, PART, PDNG, RJCT, RCVD.

errors.description: PmtInfSts = RJCT but no StsRsnInf is present at PaymentInformation level.
possible_fixes: Insert a StsRsnInf block with a valid Rsn/Cd to explain the rejection.
Use NARR with AddtlInf when no specific reason code applies.

tags.description: Unique identifier assigned by the reporting party to the status of this transaction. Optional.

errors.description: StsId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate StsId to a maximum of 35 characters preserving uniqueness.

tags.description: Original instruction identification copied unchanged from the original transaction PmtId/InstrId. Optional.

errors.description: OrgnlInstrId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 35 characters; value must still match the original PmtId/InstrId.

tags.description: Original end-to-end identification copied unchanged from the original transaction PmtId/EndToEndId. Optional but strongly recommended for reconciliation.

errors.description: OrgnlEndToEndId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 35 characters; value must still match the original PmtId/EndToEndId.

tags.description: Original transaction identification copied unchanged from the original transaction PmtId/TxId. Optional.

errors.description: OrgnlTxId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 35 characters; value must still match the original PmtId/TxId.

tags.description: Original Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference (UUID v4) copied unchanged from the original transaction PmtId/UETR. Lowercase hex.

errors.description: OrgnlUETR is not a valid UUID v4 (wrong format, uppercase, wrong version digit, or invalid variant).
possible_fixes: Ensure OrgnlUETR is lowercase hex in format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx (y in 8,9,a,b).
Convert any uppercase hex characters to lowercase.
The value must match the UETR of the original transaction; do not regenerate.

tags.description: Transaction-level status (ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus). If RJCT, at least one StsRsnInf with Rsn/Cd is mandatory.

errors.description: TxSts contains a value not in the ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus codelist.
possible_fixes: Replace with one of: ACCP, ACSC, ACSP, ACWC, ACWP, PDNG, RJCT, RCVD.
Use RJCT for a rejected transaction and ACSP for accepted-settlement-in-process.

errors.description: TxSts = RJCT but no StsRsnInf is present to explain the transaction rejection.
possible_fixes: Insert <StsRsnInf><Rsn><Cd>{reason code}</Cd></Rsn></StsRsnInf> under TxInfAndSts.
Use a valid ExternalStatusReason1Code (e.g. AC01, AM04, MS03) or NARR with AddtlInf.

tags.description: Party that issued the status reason (originator of the rejection/status). Identified by Nm and/or Id. Optional.

errors.description: StsRsnInf/Orgtr is present but contains neither Nm nor Id.
possible_fixes: Populate <Orgtr><Nm>{originator name}</Nm></Orgtr> or provide an Id, or remove the empty Orgtr block.

tags.description: Transaction-level status reason code (ExternalStatusReason1Code). Mandatory within StsRsnInf when TxSts = RJCT. Use NARR with AddtlInf when no specific code applies.

errors.description: Transaction-level StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd is not a valid ExternalStatusReason1Code.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid ExternalStatusReason1Code (e.g. AC01 incorrect account, AM04 insufficient funds, MS03 reason not specified).
Use NARR and place free-text explanation in StsRsnInf/AddtlInf when no code fits.

errors.description: StsRsnInf is present for a rejected transaction but Rsn/Cd is missing.
possible_fixes: Insert <Rsn><Cd>{ExternalStatusReason1Code}</Cd></Rsn> inside StsRsnInf.
Default to MS03 (reason not specified) or NARR with AddtlInf if the precise reason is unknown.

tags.description: Free-text additional information about the status reason. Required in practice when Rsn/Cd = NARR. Each occurrence max 105 characters.

errors.description: StsRsnInf/AddtlInf exceeds 105 characters per occurrence.
possible_fixes: Truncate each AddtlInf occurrence to 105 characters.
Split long explanations across multiple AddtlInf occurrences (each max 105 chars).

errors.description: AddtlInf contains characters outside the permitted character set.
possible_fixes: Transliterate accented/special characters to ASCII equivalents.
Remove control characters and disallowed symbols.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest GrpHdr/MsgId and set BizMsgIdr to match (or vice versa); never invent a new value.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'pain.002.001.10' and match the Document namespace
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set MsgDefIdr to pain.002.001.10 derived from the Document xmlns.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If TxSts = RJCT then at least one StsRsnInf with Rsn/Cd MUST be present for that transaction
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Insert a StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd (e.g. MS03 or NARR with AddtlInf) when TxSts = RJCT.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If GrpSts = RJCT then a group-level StsRsnInf with Rsn/Cd should be present
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Insert a StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd under OrgnlGrpInfAndSts when GrpSts = RJCT.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If PmtInfSts = RJCT then a StsRsnInf with Rsn/Cd should be present at PaymentInformation level
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Insert a StsRsnInf block under OrgnlPmtInfAndSts when PmtInfSts = RJCT.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpSts / PmtInfSts / TxSts must all be valid ExternalPaymentGroupStatus / ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus codes
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Replace any out-of-list status with a valid code (ACCP, ACSC, ACSP, ACWC, ACWP, PART, PDNG, RJCT, RCVD).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: OrgnlMsgNmId identifies the reported message type and must be a valid ISO 20022 message identifier (e.g. pain.001.001.09)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set OrgnlMsgNmId to the identifier of the original reported message.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If GrpSts = PART (partial acceptance) then per-transaction TxSts must be populated so accepted and rejected items are distinguishable
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Populate TxSts on each TxInfAndSts when GrpSts/PmtInfSts = PART.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: OrgnlInstrId / OrgnlEndToEndId / OrgnlTxId / OrgnlUETR must be copied unchanged from the original (reported) transaction
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest each original identifier from the reported message; do not regenerate.

schema_mapping_notes.root_element: Document/CstmrPmtStsRpt is the root; the message type is CustomerPaymentStatusReportV10.
schema_mapping_notes.msg_def_idr: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr = pain.002.001.10 and must match the Document xmlns urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.002.001.10.
schema_mapping_notes.biz_svc: AppHdr/BizSvc = swift.cbprplus.02 for the CBPR+ status report exchange under SR2025.
schema_mapping_notes.original_group: OrgnlGrpInfAndSts references the reported message via OrgnlMsgId (original GrpHdr/MsgId) and OrgnlMsgNmId (original message identifier, e.g. pain.001.001.09).
schema_mapping_notes.status_codelists: GrpSts/PmtInfSts use ExternalPaymentGroupStatus; TxSts uses ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus; StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd uses ExternalStatusReason1Code.
schema_mapping_notes.datetime_format: All ISODateTime fields (AppHdr/CreDt, GrpHdr/CreDtTm, OrgnlCreDtTm) use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; Z suffix and milliseconds are forbidden under CBPR+.
schema_mapping_notes.reject_reason_dependency: A RJCT status at group, payment-information or transaction level requires a corresponding StsRsnInf with Rsn/Cd.
